codes.meaning: The fixed safeguard policy is absent, malformed, or inconsistent.
An organization profile or case request attempted to weaken a fixed safeguard.
A configuration reference is missing, unresolved, or not versioned.
The source lacks an approved-for-use basis.
The source cannot be tied to a recorded SHA-256 checksum.
The retrieved source differs from the previously approved version.
The content contains prohibited credentials, private data, or restricted information.
A credential, token, key, or secret value was detected.
Untrusted text attempts to change system instructions, tools, sources, or authority.
An instruction embedded in source content was treated only as data and ignored.
The opportunity contains insufficient information for meaningful structured screening.
A request attempts to convert descriptive history into award or success prediction.
The classifier package, configuration, vocabulary, or checksum is invalid.
The model confidence is below the fixed classification threshold.
The input materially differs from the commercial-contract training domain.
The input exceeded the supported sequence length and was truncated.
The official evidence corpus has not completed version and integrity approval.
An exact requested citation was not found in the approved corpus.
The citation does not resolve to the recorded source metadata.
Material evidence is stale or its freshness cannot be established.
Validated evidence does not support a directional recommendation.
Material validated evidence conflicts and requires specialist review.
A recommendation packet omits known material counterevidence.
The recommendation omits mandatory evidence, limitations, conditions, or disclosure.
The recommendation contains claims not grounded in recorded evidence.
The output is written as an authorized or final organizational decision.
The workflow requires an authorized human disposition before finalization.
The identified reviewer does not map to an authorized role.
Legal, privacy, security, financial, staffing, or other specialist review is mandatory.
A request asks the system to send, submit, approve, purchase, price, staff, or otherwise act externally.
An audit event fails schema, sanitization, or chain validation.
The required audit event cannot be durably persisted.
An audit payload contains secrets, prohibited personal data, confidential content, or private reasoning.
A retryable operation exceeded the fixed attempt limit.
The artifact or output claims production readiness without required approvals and controls.
